def parse_filter(filter_text):
    result = {}

    if filter_text is None:
        return result

    text = str(filter_text)

    # Parse equality clauses: ("orgId" = "LIM")
    for key, val in re.findall(r'\("([^"]+)"\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"\)', text):
        result[key] = val

    # Parse IN LIST clauses: ("contextId" IN LIST 55,689,213)
    for key, vals in re.findall(r'\("([^"]+)"\s+IN\s+LIST\s+([^)]+)\)', text):
        split_vals = []
        for v in vals.split(","):
            v = v.strip().strip('"').strip("'").strip().rstrip(";")
            if v == "":
                continue
            if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d+", v):
                split_vals.append(int(v))
            else:
                split_vals.append(v)
        result[key] = split_vals

    return result

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)

ws_out = wb["Output"]
